_comment: Golden vectors for packages/engine/src/plcedge.ts, worked by hand from spec/plc-edge-semantics.md one scan at a time (not taken from the engine). pulses = scan times (ms) at which Q / ONS rung-out / OSR or OSF output bit is TRUE.

cases.name: rising: input already TRUE at power-up, a short gap, and a pulse shorter than one scan
rising: a pulse between two scans is never seen
falling: input TRUE at power-up, then off, then on again
falling: input FALSE at power-up — only a TRUE memory bit fires on the first scan

rungOut._comment: OSR passes rung-condition-in through; ONS's rung-out is the pulse itself. Same input as case 1.
